title: god-constant.json
description: Every magnitude in the worship loop, the favor economy, the interventions, ascension, stagnation and prestige — as data rather than as literals in the rules path. The *set* of ids is structural: the rules read each one by name and the loader rejects a set that is missing one or carries an unknown one. The *values* are untuned placeholders awaiting the balance harness, and each names the metric that would move it.
